title: Cache diagnostics reports previous_message_not_found on the next turn
symptoms: diagnostics shows previous_message_not_found when previous_message_id is set
Request with only the cache-diagnosis-2026-04-07 beta header is accepted but gives no diagnostic history
cause: Since September 9, 2026, the API stores a request's fingerprint only when the request includes the diagnostics object. Sending just the beta header stores nothing, so a later turn cannot find the earlier message.
fix: Include the diagnostics object on every turn. Set previous_message_id to null on the first turn and to the prior message id after that. The beta header is no longer required as of September 23, 2026.
apply: {"diagnostics": {"previous_message_id": null}}  // first turn; use the prior message id on later turns
